text:
Maya: Found a whoopee cushion under the fern by desk 4. Slightly deflated but still proud. Quick poll — who claims responsibility? :eyes:
Ethan: Not me. I would never (except that one time in college). :innocent:
Priya: I may have sat on it during testing but that was strictly quality assurance. :grimacing:
Noah: I have an alibi — was on a call with Jamie from 10:00-10:45, hear me on the record. :raised_hands:
Zoe: Confession: I bought it for the team swap but forgot who it was for. It's officially in the community pool. :shrug:
Harper: Vote: Keep it in the snack cabinet (for morale) or return to sender? react with :thumbsup: to keep, :wave: to return
ops-bot: POLL created — "Who should own the whoopee cushion?" Choices: Keep / Return / Lost Cause. Vote with reactions.
Maya: Also propose a transfer protocol: winner supplies one bag of chips. Rules. :chip:
Ethan: Chips are expensive now, propose cookies instead. :cookie:
Priya: I'll bake cookies if I'm elected. Conditions: gluten-free option included. :blush:
Noah: Official motion to rename desk 4 "The Chamber of Giggles". Seconded. :laughing:
Zoe: Seconded. Also — who cleaned the coffee ring in Conference B? Not related. :sweat_smile:
Maya: Thread closed pending poll results. Poll ends in 2 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
